calls.title: Growthbook <> PhonePe
calls.summary: The meeting focused on outlining a four-phase workflow for seamlessly integrating Growth Book with PhonePe's existing systems. This includes initial experiment setup, linking to PhonePe’s business context, manual approvals to prevent unintended launches, and exposure logging for analysis. Key integration challenges discussed were the synchronization of experiment states between Growth Book and PhonePe's Ablaze and Chimera systems, along with the strategy of using Chimera as the central configuration system while exploring Growth Book's feature flags. Enhancements to the approval flow were also a priority, aiming for a maker-checker workflow to ensure responsible management of experiments. Lastly, the need for SSO integration with Olympus for authentication and identifying primary blockers for progress were emphasized.
calls.keywords: Experiment Setup, Maker-Checker Flow, Chimera Integration, Feature Flags, SSO Authentication, State Synchronization

calls.title: GrowthBook / PhonePe
calls.summary: The team discussed challenges related to users switching buckets mid-experiment and the optimal strategies for managing phased rollout data in GrowthBook. Luke Sonnet explained the non-switching bucket model, advising balanced splits for experiments to maintain integrity. Jinan noted that bucket switching triggers multiple exposure events, leading to inconsistencies. In distinguishing rollouts from true experiments, Sharath highlighted the necessity of fixed bucket assignments for reliable metrics. They explored strategies for validating bucket switching and suggested full data reloads for complex cases. The conversation also covered managing multiple projects within GrowthBook, using filtering for data governance, and how to handle partition configuration issues post-update. Members noted the importance of collaboration and sharing best practices to enhance GrowthBook's effectiveness.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook SDK, incremental load, bucket switching, experiment rollout, data source configuration, multi-project governance

calls.title: GrowthBook / PhonePe
calls.summary: The session outlined the upcoming GrowthBook upgrade, highlighting features such as full data retention and incremental load capabilities. The upgrade is set for this week and includes backward compatibility, ensuring existing data is preserved. A new data model will consolidate multiple tables into fewer, enhancing efficiency and performance by focusing on active metrics. Discussion also covered the handling of expired experiments, noting that archiving isn't recommended due to limited performance gains. Query observability will improve with the addition of metadata to Trino queries for better user tracking. Ongoing weekly meetings were emphasized for support in onboarding and scaling GrowthBook operations effectively.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook upgrade, incremental load, data model, metric partitioning, experiment archiving, Trino query metadata
